newsitem.title: USA: Guilford offering brings in $74.8 million.
newsitem.headline: Guilford offering brings in $74.8 million.

text.p: Guilford Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Monday that the underwriters for its recently announced stock offering have exercised their over-allotment option in full to purchase 487,500 additional shares at a price to the public of $20 each.
That will add $9.75 million to the gross proceeds from the offering, bringing them to a total of $74.75 million, the company said.
The offering was managed by Oppenheimer & Co Inc, Alex. Brown Inc and Hambrecht & Quist LLC.
Guilford is a biopharmaceutical company. Its stock was trading up 31/32 to 22-15/32 on Monday.
